spec.name: Polar Dusk Outpost
spec.description: A Firewatch-style diorama of a red-timbered arctic research station on stilts, with a radome, wind turbine, weather mast and a snowmobile yard, under a flat layered sunset of purple ridges and a huge orange sun.
spec.layout: A square snow-slab diorama 7.2 x 7.2 m, with ground at y=0.4 (drifts up to 0.45). A flat sunset backdrop wall stands along the back edge (z -3.6 to -2.95), 5.0 m tall. It is made of stacked horizontal sky bands (purple at the top, magenta, then coral at the horizon), a huge sun disc with 2 translucent-looking halo rings in flat warm colours, 3 layered ridge silhouettes (far pink, mid plum, near dark violet, each a thin extrude at a slightly different z) and a few flat aurora ribbons in iceBlue. The hero is the main cabin at the centre (x -1.9..1.9, z -1.4..1.9): a long red timber lab cabin on 8 short stilts, deck at y=0.95, with the porch and door on the FRONT (+Z). It has cream window frames with glowing windows, a dark pitched roof ridge running along X (ridge y~3.0), a stove chimney with a smoke puff, and an outdoor stair down to the snow. Behind it (z -2.9..-1.5) stand the instruments: a white-and-cream radome on a short lattice tower at the left (x -2.3), a wind turbine at the right (x 2.4, hub y 3.4, rotor facing +Z), and a tall weather mast at x 0.2 with an anemometer on top and a small solar panel rack beside it. The yard (z in front, plus left and right sides, outside the cabin box) holds a snowmobile and sled on the left (x ~ -2.6, z 0.6), a crate-and-fuel-drum stack on the right (x ~ 2.6, z 0.3), and on the front zone a flag pole, an ice-core rack and an orange survey tent. A frozen pond sits front right (x 1.5..3.2, z 1.8..3.3) and belongs to the base. STYLE (Firewatch flat colour): no gradients and no noise. Every shape is a bold flat colour with chunky blocky silhouettes. Light faces are warm (snowLit, pink-cream), shaded undersides and snow shadows are cool violet (snowShadow, snowDeep), and every object has a small dark violet-ink underside or outline strip where it meets the ground. Keep shapes simple and add detail as small flat-colour parts (window panes, plank seams, rivets, stripes). Use warm sunset hues everywhere and no pure white or pure black.

parts.builds: The diorama slab: a chunky low-poly snow plinth, 7.2 x 7.2 m, top at y=0.4 with a darker snowShadow/snowDeep side skirt and a thin ink strip at the bottom, and ice-blue strata lines on the sides. On top: a few soft flat drift mounds (snowLit tops, snowShadow lee sides, up to y 0.45) kept away from the cabin footprint, a frozen pond (iceBlue disc with an iceDark rim, pale crack lines and a small round fishing hole) at the mount pondCenter, a trampled path of snowShadow flat strips from stairFoot to the front edge with small footprint ovals, and sled-track lines to the snowmobile pad. Add a few angular rocks (rock with snowLit caps) at the edges and corners, and 2-3 small ice crystals. Leave the areas for the cabin, yard objects and instrument bases free. It owns nothing above y 0.5.
parts.attaches: Top surface at the mount ground (y 0.4). Every other part rests on it. The backdrop starts at backdropFront z -2.95.

parts.builds: The hero research cabin facing +Z, built as a blocky puppet: 8 woodDark/wood stilts from ground to the deck at y 0.95, with cross-braces and snowLit drifts at their feet; a deck slab; cabinRed walls (x -1.7..1.7, z -1.3..0.7, y 0.95..2.35) with darker cabinDark plank seam strips and corner posts; trimCream window frames with windowGlow panes (3 on the front, 2 on each side, 2 on the back, each pane with a thin cross muntin) and small awning slabs; a porch deck (z 0.7..1.9, x -0.2..1.5) with a railing (wood posts and rail), a front door at doorCenter (wood, with a round window, a cream frame and a small lantern in windowGlow), an outdoor stair of 6 steps from porchEdge down to stairFoot with two stringers, and a snow stripe on each tread; a dark roofDark pitched roof (ridge y 3.0, along X) with overhanging eaves, a trimCream fascia, snowLit snow caps on the upper roof with chunky drip edges, a stove chimney (metal with a rock-cap, at x -1.0) with 2 flat smoke puffs of snowShadow and snowLit rising to y 3.9, a small red-and-cream sign board over the door reading a simple glyph, a side vent box and a stack of firewood (wood logs with trimCream ends) on the left side wall, and a small generator shed attached to the right wall (cabinDark, with a metal pipe). Bright windowGlow sparkle, an ink-coloured shadow band under the eaves.
parts.attaches: Stilts stand on the ground mount (y 0.4). The stair foot ends at stairFoot [0.6, 0.4, 2.7], which lies just outside the box; the path from the base starts there. Keep clear of the instruments at z < -1.5.

parts.builds: The scientific gear behind the cabin, z -2.9..-1.5. (1) A radome at radomeBase: a three-legged metal lattice tower (metalLight, with cross-braces) about 1.4 m tall carrying a faceted trimCream/snowLit dome (about 0.9 m across, from a low-poly sphere) with panel seam lines in snowShadow, a red beacon light and a small hatch; the dome centre is near y 2.4. (2) A wind turbine at turbineBase: a tapered white-cream tower to the hub at turbineHub [2.4, 3.4, -1.95], a nacelle box with a cabinRed nose cone, and three tapered blades, 1.0 m long, on the joint turbineRotor (rigged to the joint, facing +Z, blades at 0, 120 and 240 degrees, with a sunOrange tip stripe on each) — the hub and blades ride the joint turbineRotor. (3) A weather mast at mastBase: a thin metal pole up to y 4.5 with 2 cross-arms, guy wires (thin ink rods) anchored in the snow, a small instrument box, and an anemometer on top riding the joint anemometer (3 cups on arms, sunOrange cups). (4) A solar panel rack at x 0.9..1.7, with 2 tilted iceDark panels with lighter grid lines and a metal frame on legs, tilted to face +Z. (5) A little Stevenson-screen weather box (trimCream louvers, wood legs) near x -0.9. Add snow drifts piled at all bases and a thin ink-coloured cable run from the mast base towards the cabin back wall, ending at (0, 1.1, -1.4).
parts.attaches: Bases stand on the ground mount (y 0.4) at radomeBase, mastBase and turbineBase. Its cable ends at the back wall of the mainCabin (z -1.4). The backdrop is behind at z < -2.95.

parts.builds: Everything staged around the cabin outside the cabin box (x -1.9..1.9, z -1.4..1.9), and out of the pond (x 1.5..3.2, z 1.8..3.3), in blocky puppet style. (1) A snowmobile at snowmobilePad, facing +Z: a cabinRed body, a black-ink seat, a trimCream windscreen, a headlight in windowGlow, ski runners (metal) front and a track block rear with snow-capped tread details, and a sunOrange stripe; behind it a wooden sled (wood, woodDark runners) carrying a tarp-covered load (sunOrange tarp, with rope lines) and two small boxes. (2) A stack of cargo at cratePad: 5 wooden crates (wood with woodDark slats and a stencilled trimCream glyph) stacked in a pyramid, with 3 fuel drums (sunOrange and cabinDark, with ink bands, metal lids and bungs) beside them and a snow cap on top. (3) In front: a flag pole at flagPad (metal pole, a cabinRed flag with a trimCream stripe, flat but a few facets tall), an ice-core rack (a wood A-frame with 6 horizontal iceBlue core tubes) near x 0.2, z 2.8, and an orange survey tent at tentPad (a sunOrange low pyramid or dome with trimCream guy lines, a dark door flap and snow skirts). Add a pair of skis and poles leaning against the cabin front-left stair rail (outside the cabin box, so near x -2.1, z 1.9), and a lone ice axe in a snowdrift. All objects get a small snowShadow drift at the base.
parts.attaches: All items rest on the ground mount (y 0.4) at their named pads. Keep clear of the pond region (x 1.5..3.2, z 1.8..3.3), the path from stairFoot, and the cabin box.

parts.builds: A flat sunset diorama wall along the back edge (z -3.6..-2.95, x -3.6..3.6, standing on the base from y 0.4 to 5.0), built from thin extrudes or slabs in a stack of z layers. Layer 1 (z ~ -3.55): sky bands as full-width horizontal strips: skyTop at the top, then skyMid, then skyGlow at the horizon, with a thin sunOrange band right above the ridges. Layer 2: a huge sun disc at sunCenter [1.2, 3.3, -3.45], radius about 0.75, in sunYellow with a sunOrange ring and 2 larger halo rings (skyGlow tones, flat) behind it, and a few thin flat horizontal cloud streaks in ridgeFar and skyMid across the sky. Layer 3: aurora ribbons, 2-3 wavy thin extruded bands in iceBlue and trimCream near the top. Layer 4: far ridge silhouette (ridgeFar, jagged peaks up to y 2.8) at z -3.4. Layer 5: mid ridge (ridgeMid, peaks up to y 2.2) at z -3.3 with snowLit snow-cap triangles on peaks. Layer 6: near ridge (ridgeNear, peaks up to y 1.5) at z -3.15 with a few tiny snowLit highlights on the sunward slopes. Frame the wall with a thin ink-coloured border (a flat box frame around the edge, 0.08 m) so it reads like a stage flat, plus two rear brace struts at the back. All pieces are flat-coloured, tall angular silhouettes with sharp peaks. The sun and ridges must not intrude on z > -2.95, so leave the instrument zone free.
parts.attaches: Stands on the base's back edge at y 0.4. Its front face is at backdropFront z -2.95. The mast top (y 4.5) and turbine blades (up to y 4.4) stand in front of it.

calls.reasoning:
I'm settling on the look first: a Firewatch-style flat palette of warm sunset oranges, pinks and purples, but set in the arctic with snow, ice and pine silhouettes. The outpost is the focus, with only a simple snowy base slab under it. I'm also sketching a rough size for the base, roughly 8 by 8 with a height around 4.5, though I'm still weighing those numbers.

I'm sizing the base to a 7 by 7 footprint at about 4.6 tall, then breaking the diorama into five parts. The terrain is a snowy ice slab with drifts and rocks, sitting at about y=0.4. I'm also laying out the main lab on stilts and weighing where the instrument mast and wind turbine should go on the back right.

I'm placing the cabin on the middle line of the base, and I'm fixing the instrument cluster behind it at the back, with the radome and wind turbine on either side of a ground-level mast. The front yard gets its own box for the snowmobile, fuel drums, crates, tent and the other gear.

I'm weighing a sky backdrop of layered flat mountain ridges with a big sunset disc behind the outpost. The fit is tight, since the instruments sit at the back, so I'm considering stretching the diorama's length to about 8 to make room for it.

I'm working out the backdrop now: layered flat ridges at the back, a sun disc with halo rings, and a size of about 7.2 by 5 by 7.2 so everything fits, with the base slab running from -3.6 to 3.6.

I'm adding aurora bands to the backdrop, then turning to the base, which will get drifts, ice cracks and a frozen pond. I'm also weighing whether the model should have joints, probably a root with rotating turbine and anemometer parts.

I'm setting the joints now: the outpost root is the spine, with the wind turbine rotor and the anemometer as hinges on the instrument side, and everything else riding on the root. I'm also picking the palette, starting with a deep purple sky top and a mid-tone magenta, with the sun's orange still to be settled.

I'm listing the colour palette now, with warm snow whites, icy blues, rock greys, a red cabin with cream trim, wood tones, and warm window glow.

I'm checking the colour list against the limit of 24, adding a few more candidates and then trimming it to exactly 24 by dropping the extras.

I'm placing the cabin on stilts, with its walls running from the deck up to a ridge roof, and a porch and stair on the front side facing the yard. The cabin footprint spans the middle of the base, and the yard box begins just in front of the porch.

I'm laying out the yard's footprint so it doesn't collide with the cabin: the cabin takes the middle block, and the yard fills the space around it, with the snowmobile set out to the side.

I'm placing the cabin's chimney on the roof at x=-1.0, with the cabin box running up to 3.9 to take in the smoke puffs. Then I'm turning to the instruments: the radome base goes on a tower at x=-2.3, z=-2.3, and the wind turbine at x=2.4, z=-2.2, with its hub around 3.3 and blades reaching roughly 4.3, while I'm still weighing where the mast fits.

I'm placing the instrument joints now: the anemometer sits up on the mast at about y=4.5, and the turbine rotor is set on the hub at the right side of the back.

I'm placing the backdrop as a box behind the instruments, with the ridge layers at the far back, the sun disc off to the right, and a sky panel built from stacked horizontal gradient strips from deep purple at the top down to the orange horizon.

I'm placing the pond at the right front corner of the base, where the yard can keep clear of it, and setting the ice drill and a small fishing hole beside it.

I'm placing the yard on the left side with the snowmobile and its sled, and setting the crates and fuel drums on the right, with the orange tent in the front-left corner.

I'm placing the yard's pieces around the base: the snowmobile and sled on the left, the crate stack and fuel drums on the right, and the flag pole, ice-core rack and orange survey tent in the front zone, keeping clear of the pond.
